output:
Hi Kamal,

Thank you for thinking of {{VENUE_NAME}} — a seated dinner for 90 is right in our wheelhouse. Taking your questions in order:

Availability — {{AVAILABLE_DATES}} are open from your list.

The space — a full buyout gives you the whole restaurant, which at 90 for a seated dinner is the right call. {{ROOM_DESCRIPTION}}

Cost — a full buyout on a {{DAY}} carries a food and beverage minimum of {{MINIMUM}}. There's no separate room rental. A {{SERVICE_PCT}} service charge and {{TAX_PCT}} tax apply on top.

Menus — attached. Groups pre-select from these; nothing needs deciding now.

To hold a date we send a contract and collect {{DEPOSIT_PCT}} of the minimum. Selections and final count can move after signing.

{{VENUE_NAME}} Events
